senses.gloss:
Gau-ṣūkti is the name of a pupil of iṣa śyāvāśvi according to the Jaiminīya upaniṣad brāhmaṇa in a vaṃśa (list of teachers). It is also the name, in the pañcaviṃśa brāhmaṇa, of a teacher who appears to have been needlessly invented to explain the Gauṣūkta sāman (chant), which is really the sāman of goṣūktin.
Foot notes iv. 16, 1.
xix. 4, 9. Cf. St. Petersburg Dictionary, s.v.; Hopkins, Transactions of the Connecticut Academy of Arts and Sciences, 15, 30.
